observation_scope: Nonblind original-image layout comparison. Radial texts face inward. Clockwise sequence and clockwise clock annotations agree overall. Small original tiles were inspected without rotating or repainting glyphs; a complete independent paleographic reading of28 labels was NOT performed.
repeat_evidence: The exact okeod repeat relies on ZL/IT agreement at f69v.14,.18,.27. Image views do not constitute a third independent transcription.
historical_reading_note: Leupold prints Latin descriptors with zodiac symbols. Item7 shows Leo, unlike the Gemini wording in Agrippa English; retain the source discrepancy. Arabic-derived names come from the later Agrippa edition only.
